content: Xekeneyuparewieka

Peru ne'iwama, xɨka xewitɨ 'axatiuyurieme 'utaxeiyarieni, xeme 'axemu'uwa 'Iyaritsie xetewiyatɨ, xekeneheitseritɨaka kemɨ'ane mɨpaɨ mɨtiuyuri, tixaɨtɨ xekate'ayuyeitɨatɨ yu'iyaritsie. Matsi xeyukweriwayurietɨ, kapa xemeta xe'uta'inierienikɨ 'axaxemɨteyurienikɨ.
Yuxexuitɨ xekeneyuparewieka yu'ikakɨ, mɨpaɨ xeteyurietɨ Kɨritsitu 'inɨarieya xekanaye'atɨakuni.
Xɨka xewitɨ tixaɨtɨ tihɨkɨtɨme yu'erieka, matsi xɨka tixaɨtɨ katihɨkɨtɨni, yɨkɨmana katiniyu'itaiyamɨkɨ.
Yuxexuitɨ mekeyu'inɨatani kememɨteyurie, mɨkɨkɨ kaniyutemawiekamɨkɨ yuhepaɨtsita, yuta'inɨatame kemɨtiuyuri yuxaɨtame, hipatɨ kememɨte'uyuri yakara'eriwatɨ.
Yuxexuitɨ yu'ikakɨ kememɨte'uhɨritɨarie meke'etɨkɨni.
Kemɨ'ane mɨti'ɨkitɨarie niuki hepaɨtsita, mɨkɨ keyuxewini kemɨ'ane mɨti'ɨkitɨa hamatɨa, naime 'aixɨa mɨti'anekɨ 'iparewietɨ.
Xepɨkateyu'itaiyani, Kakaɨyari pɨkayunanaimarinɨa. Tewi kemɨtiuka'e, mɨpaɨ pɨtiu'itsana.
Kemɨ'ane yuwaiyaritsie xeikɨa mɨtiuka'e, waiyarieya pitixuawitɨirieni pɨniya, 'ika'itsanayu. Kemɨ'ane 'Iyaritsie mɨtiuka'e, 'Iyari pitixuawitɨirieni tukari mɨkaxɨwe, 'ika'itsanayu.
Tepɨka'u'uxeni 'aixɨa teteyurietɨ, tukari 'aye'ayu tepɨ'itsanani xɨka tekate'uhayewa mexi'akuxi ka'aye'awe.
'Ayumieme, ketemɨteyɨwawe 'aixɨa tekewayurieka yunaime, matsi yemekɨ mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari niwemaama yuri memɨte'erie.
Papuru kemɨtiyutemawiekai he'eriwatɨ kemɨtiumierie Kɨritsitu kuruxitsie
Neuxei, nepɨtixe'utuirie nemamakɨ 'utɨarika 'apapamekɨ.

Mɨkɨ 'aixɨa memɨtexeiyarienikɨ xekɨa memɨyɨa, mɨkɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni waɨriyarika memɨxepitɨa xitekiya 'inɨariyari xemɨwewiyarienikɨ. Peru mɨpaɨ xeikɨa mekateniyurieka, memɨkataweiyariexɨanikɨ Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi kuruxieya hepaɨtsita.

Mɨkɨ memɨyu'aita xitekiya 'inɨariyari memɨwewiyarienikɨ, yamepɨkatekahu 'inɨari niukiyari kemɨti'aita. Kaniwanakeni xeikɨa xeme xemɨ'inɨaritɨarienikɨ, mɨkɨkɨ memɨyutemamawiekakɨ, meha'eriwatɨ herie kexemɨte'u'inɨaritɨarie.

Perutsɨ ne pɨkatixaɨ, yemekɨ nepɨkanetemawieka hipame waɨkawame nera'eriwatɨ, Tati'aitɨwame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu kemɨtiumierie kuruxitsie nehe'eriwatɨ, mɨkɨkɨ xeikɨa nepɨnetemawieka. Neta nepumierie 'anemɨka'uyeikanikɨ tita kwiepa mɨtimieme hetsie netiwiyatɨ.
Tsepa xitekiya 'inɨariyari muwewiyarie, yatɨni tsepa mɨka'uwewiyarie, matsi pɨta kaneuyeweka hekwamekɨ xeikɨa mɨtinuiwa.
Keyupaɨmetɨ 'amemu'uwa 'ikɨ 'inɨarikɨ, xɨka meka'uximatɨarieka yu'iyaritsie, xɨka menenimayatsieka, mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari 'Ixaheritsixi mɨtiwaruterɨwa.
'Uxa'atɨni warie xewitɨ pɨkanetsi'uximatɨaka. Newaiyaritsie 'iwaɨyɨ 'inɨariyari nepexeiya Ketsutsi hepaɨ.
Ne'iwama, Tati'aitɨwame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu 'aixɨa kemɨtiuka'iyari yuxexuime xe'iyaritsie keyekani. Mɨpaɨ xeikɨa kani'aneni.
